lines.text: Hello, friends! I am Milo the bluebird.
Today we are going to play a guessing game!
Four animal friends are hiding.
I will give you three clues. Then you guess who it is.
Put on your thinking cap. Are you ready? Let's play!
Guess who! Here are three clues.
Clue one. This friend looks like a horse.
Clue two. This friend has black and white stripes.
Clue three. This friend lives on the sunny, grassy savanna. Who is it?
It is the zebra! Great guessing!
Now, here is the fun fact. A zebra's stripes help keep the pesky flies away!
Look. The flies land on the plain brown horse.
But on the stripy zebra? The stripes mix the flies up. They cannot land!
Say it with me. Stripes keep the flies away!
Can you gallop like a zebra? Clip, clop, clip, clop!
What a great gallop!
Guess who! Here are three clues.
Clue one. This friend is pink, with a curly tail.
Clue two. This friend lives on the farm.
Clue three. This friend says oink, oink! Who is it?
It is the pig! You got it!
What does a pig do on a hot, sunny day? Here is the fun fact.
Pigs roll in the mud to keep cool!
When you are hot, you sweat. But a pig cannot sweat much.
So the pig rolls in cool, squishy mud. The mud even stops sunburn, like sunscreen!
Say it with me. Pigs roll in mud to keep cool!
Can you roll your arms like a pig in the mud? Roll, roll, roll!
Super rolling!
Guess who! Here are three clues.
Clue one. This friend is gray and fluffy, with a big black nose.
Clue two. This friend loves to hug a tree.
Clue three. This friend munches on green leaves. Who is it?
It is the koala! Well done!
Now, a tricky question. Is a koala a bear?
No! Here is the fun fact. A koala is not a bear!
Look. This is a bear. A bear has no pouch.
But a mama koala has a pouch on her tummy, like a cozy pocket. Her baby rides inside!
A baby koala is called a joey.
Say it with me. A koala is not a bear!
Can you hug yourself, like a koala hugs a tree? Squeeze!
What a lovely hug!
Guess who! Here are three clues.
Clue one. This friend is very big and very fluffy.
Clue two. This friend lives where it is icy and cold.
Clue three. This friend looks as white as snow. Who is it?
It is the polar bear! Hooray!
Can a polar bear swim?
Yes! Here is the fun fact. Polar bears are super swimmers!
Look at those big front paws. They work like paddles in the water.
Each paw is as big as a dinner plate!
Say it with me. Polar bears are super swimmers!
Can you paddle your paws like a polar bear? Paddle, paddle, paddle!
Splendid swimming!
Wow! You guessed all four friends. Now it is quiz time!
Get ready. Think hard!
Whose stripes keep the flies away?
The zebra! Yes!
Who rolls in the mud to keep cool?
The pig! That's right!
Who is not a bear, and rides in a pouch as a baby?
The koala! Good job!
Whose paws are as big as dinner plates?
The polar bear! You remembered!
You learned four new things today.
Gallop like a zebra. Roll like a pig. Hug like a koala. And paddle like a polar bear!
Which friend was the hardest to guess?
Thank you for playing with me. Bye-bye, friends! See you next time!
